name: Chrishrama in Need of an Apprentice
description:
The Arcforging master, Chrishrama of Sleepywood, seems to be searching for someone who could become his apprentice.
The Arcforging master, Chrishrama of Sleepywood, gave me a test after I asked to become his apprentice. He said true Arcforgers must possess great wisdom and instructed me to defeat monsters around Sleepywood and collect 1 Garnet Ore.
I passed the test given by the Arcforging master, Chrishrama of Sleepywood. Does this mean I can finally stand as a true Arcforger of Maple World

name: An Arcforger in My Own Right!
description:
It seems the Arcforging master Chrishrama of Sleepywood is finally ready to recognize my Arcforging skills.
The Arcforging master, Chrishrama of Sleepywood, was impressed with my growth and challenged me to prove my skill. I need to defeat Horny Mushrooms and craft 1 Topaz to bring back to him.
Amazed by my craftsmanship, the Arcforging master Chrishrama of Sleepywood handed me a Scroll Crafting Catalyst. It appears to be a special item that can be used during crafting to create even stronger scrolls. Should I give it a try

name: Chrishrama in Need of Help
description:
The Arcforging master Chrishrama of Sleepywood seems to need help. Perhaps I should visit him again.
The Arcforging master, Chrishrama of Sleepywood, received an important research request, but he's been struggling due to a lack of materials. I'll need to defeat Green Mushrooms and gather 10 Fragment of Magic to help him out.
I was able to safely deliver the item requested by the Arcforging master Chrishrama of Sleepywood. Does this mean I can now be called his true apprentice

name: Welcome to the Free Market!
description:
Lewis in the Free Market Entrance is looking for an adventurer to help him. It seems the Free Market can be accessed through Henesys or Perion.
Lewis in the Free Market Entrance asked me to deliver a letter to Chief Stan in Henesys to help revitalize the Free Market.
I delivered Lewis's letter to Chief Stan in Henesys.

name: Chief Stan's Reply
description:
Chief Stan in Henesys seems to want to send a reply to Lewis in the Free Market Entrance.
Chief Stan in Henesys asked me to deliver a reply to Lewis in the Free Market Entrance.
I delivered Chief Stan's letter to Lewis in the Free Market Entrance.

name: Asking Perion for Help
description:
Lewis in the Free Market Entrance seems to have another favor.
This time, Lewis in the Free Market Entrance asked me to deliver a letter to Dances with Balrog in Perion.
I delivered Lewis's letter to Dances with Balrog in Perion.

name: Dances with Balrog's Reply
description:
Dances with Balrog in Perion seems to want to send a reply to Lewis in the Free Market Entrance.
Dances with Balrog in Perion asked me to deliver a reply to Lewis in the Free Market Entrance.
I delivered Dances with Balrog's letter to Lewis in the Free Market Entrance.

name: [Event] A Strange and Familiar Wood
description:
Look for Arwen the Fairy in Ellinia. It seems she has a favor to ask me.
Take the Strange Mushroom Spore Strange Mushroom Spore from Arwen the Fairy to Grendel the Really Old for analysis. Then, talk to Arwen the Fairy again.
I informed Arwen the Fairy of the results of Grendel the Really Old's analysis on the Strange Mushroom Spore Strange Mushroom Spore.

name: [Event] Beyond the Unknown
description:
Arwen the Fairy in Ellinia wants to speak with me again about the Strange Mushroom Spore Strange Mushroom Spore from last time.
I need to head to The Tree Tunnel At the Forest Up North to find the bizarre cave entrance and investigate its surroundings for Arwen the Fairy.
I delivered the Glowing Mushroom Glowing Mushroom from the cave entrance to Arwen the Fairy.

name: [Event] The One Who Sealed the Darkness
description:
Grendel the Really Old has something to say about the newly discovered bizarre cave entrance...
Grendel the Really Old is worried that there might be a problem with the World Tree and asked me to talk to Manji in Perion about it.
I couldn't get any answers from Manji... but I was able to see the battle he fought beneath the World Tree.

name: [Event] Gathering Leaves
description:
The Maple Administrator in Henesys has something to say regarding the mysterious letters dropping from monsters lately.
I need to collect the mysterious letters dropped by monsters level 10 and above, such as Ribbon Pig, Dark Stump, Octopus, and Green Mushroom. I can exchange them with the Maple Administrator in Henesys for a gift that'll help me in my adventure...
I've already collected all the mysterious letters and exchanged them for a gift today. Let's visit the Maple Administrator in Henesys again tomorrow.

name: [Event] Gift for the New Journey
description:
There's a special gift for the brave adventurers setting off on a new journey in Classic World...
I've obtained the Gift for the New Journey Gift for the New Journey. It should come in handy for my future adventures.

name: [Event] A New Adventure Awaits
description:
Betty has just completed her latest research and needs someone to deliver the report across the sea.
Deliver Betty's research report to Cherry, the sailor who voyages to and from Ossyria. You can find her at Ellinia Station.
You delivered Betty's research report to Cherry. Now that I've come all this way... why not hop aboard the ship bound for Ossyria

name: [Event] Growing Leaf
description:
The Maple Administrator in Henesys is handing out Pale Maple Leaf Pale Maple Leaf for a special event! Nurture yours and see what it becomes...
Hold on to your Pale Maple Leaf Pale Maple Leaf and stay online for 60 minutes. As time passes, the leaf will slowly turn into a Reddened Maple Leaf Reddened Maple Leaf. Keep playing and let it grow! If you lost the leaf, forfeit the quest to receive another one.
Your Pale Maple Leaf Pale Maple Leaf has grown into a Reddened Maple Leaf Reddened Maple Leaf!

name: [Event] Halloween Candies
description:
Malady in Henesys and Kerning City has a favor to ask. Go and hear what she has to say.
Malady in Henesys and Kerning City has had her stash of Halloween Candies carried off by monsters. Halloween Candies dropped by monsters level 10 and above, such as Ribbon Pig, Dark Stump, Octopus, and Green Mushroom. Only characters at Level 10 or higher can complete this quest.
All the Halloween Candies has been returned to Malady. Halloween is back on schedule.

name: [Event] Trick or Treat!
description:
Malady in Henesys and Kerning City says there's still one more thing left to do for Halloween...
Malady has split her Halloween Candy into three pouches for the children spending Halloween alone. Deliver a pouch to the child in the dark tunnel, the child on the open field and the child up on the high ground. Only characters at Level 10 or higher can complete this quest.
All three children received their Halloween Candy. Malady kept her word and handed over the reward.

name: To Henesys, the Prairie Town
description:
Mentally exhausted from endless adventuring, a peaceful rest sounds pretty good right now.
It seems Henesys offers various services for adventurers. I should drop by Henesys if I'm ever in the area. Only characters at Level 12 or higher can complete this quest.
Arthur, the Town Clerk I met at Henesys Town Hall, suggested I become a resident of Henesys. Once I've made up my mind, I should speak with Arthur for more details.

name: First Greeting with Rina, the Town Resident
description:
It looks like Arthur, the town clerk, is looking for someone to help with their work. Let's go check out Community Board in front of Henesys Town Hall.
Arthur, the town clerk, asked me to greet Rina, a resident of the town. Since I've become a resident here too, greeting the townspeople is a given, right Only characters at Level 12 or higher can complete this quest.
I greeted Rina, a resident of Henesys. I have a feeling we're going to get along great!

name: Asking After Rina, the Town Resident
description:
It looks like Arthur, the town clerk, is looking for someone to help with their work. Let's go check out Community Board in front of Henesys Town Hall.
Arthur, the town clerk, asked me to check on Rina, a resident of the town. Let's go see how Rina is doing. Only characters at Level 12 or higher can complete this quest.
I checked on Rina, a resident of Henesys. I'm glad to see she's doing well!

name: Donating to Henesys
description:
Arthur, the town clerk, seems to be looking for items needed to manage Henesys. Let's go see Community Board in front of Henesys Town Hall.
Arthur, the town clerk, requested a donation of 30 Blue Snail Shells for Henesys. Only characters at Level 12 or higher can complete this quest.
I gathered the items requested by Arthur, the town clerk, and brought them to him. I'm glad I could contribute to the development of our town.
